        if panel.getpixel((xy[0]+x,xy[1]+y)) "'!= rgb:
            mismatch += 1

positions=[tuple(p['product_image_xy']) for p in metadata['panels']]
arc_spans=[span for p in metadata['panels'] for span in p['arc_spans_degrees']]

 'panel_positions':positions,
 'unique_panel_positions':sorted(set(positions)),
 'pixel_checks':checks,
 'arc_spans':arc_spans,
 'all_arcs_open_under_180':all(0 < s < 180 for s in arc_spans),

 'particle_counts':[p['particle_count'] for p in metadata['panels']],
 'copy_flat':[text for values in metadata['consumer_copy'].values() for text in values],

}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
